const result = await tools.exec_command({cmd: "python3 - <<'PY'
import re, json, difflib
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('input.md').read_text()
parts=re.split(r'(?m)^## (sample-\d+)\n',s)
for i in range(1,len(parts),2):
    sample, body=parts[i:i+2]
    art=re.search(r'### Delivered Text Artifact\n\n```text\n(.*?)\n```',body,re.S)
    supplied=re.search(r'### Complete supplied input\n\n```text\n(.*?)\n```',body,re.S)
    if not art:
        print(json.dumps({'id':sample, 'artifact':False}))
        continue
    a=art.group(1)
    content=re.sub(r'\A---\n.*?\n---\n','',a,flags=re.S).strip()
    paras=re.split(r'\n\s*\n',content)
    title=paras[0].removeprefix('# ')
    stand=re.sub(r'\*\*','',paras[1])
    heads=re.findall(r'(?m)^## (.*)$',a)
    out={'id':sample, 'headline_chars':len(title), 'standfirst_words':len(stand.split()), 'subhead_chars':[len(h) for h in heads], 'artifact_words':len(content.split())}
    print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
    if supplied:
        b=supplied.group(1)
        print('\n'.join(difflib.unified_diff(b.splitlines(),a.splitlines(),n=0,lineterm='')))
PY", max_output_tokens: 10500});
text(result.output);
